prompt: Build the Chinese internet meme character 大笑奶龙 (Laughing Nailong, also called 奶蛙) in 3D with three.js from memory, as it appears in the meme. No reference image is provided. Task (3D, static, from memory): write an HTML page that builds the character from code and renders it from your reference camera. For this static task, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>大笑奶龙</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:240px;height:240px;overflow:hidden;background:#cbdfe5}
canvas{display:block;width:240px;height:240px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240, 240, false);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xcbdfe5);
const pi = Math.PI;
const vec = (x,y,z) => new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z);
const color = hex => new THREE.Color(hex);
const clamp = THREE.MathUtils.clamp;
const mix = THREE.MathUtils.lerp;

function group(parent,name) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name = name;
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}

const dragon = group(scene,'大笑奶龙 · Laughing Nailong');
const trunk = group(dragon,'Pear-shaped body');
const head = group(dragon,'Head thrown back in laughter');
head.position.set(0,2.245,.105);
head.rotation.set(-.115,-.045,-.049,'YXZ');

const gold = color(0xffcb32);
const butter = color(0xffdc57);
const nostrilBrown = color(0x996525);
const skin = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color:gold, roughness:.72
});
const paintedSkin = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  vertexColors:true, roughness:.72
});
const eyeMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color:0x302019, roughness:.53
});

function mesh(parent,name,geometry,material) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(geometry,material);
  m.name = name;
  parent.add(m);
  return m;
}

// A smoothly interpolated series of cross sections.
function profile(values,s) {
  const end = values.length-1;
  s = clamp(s,0,end);
  const i = Math.min(Math.floor(s),end-1);
  const t = s-i;
  const a = values[Math.max(0,i-1)], b = values[i];
  const c = values[i+1], d = values[Math.min(end,i+2)];
  return b+.5*t*((c-a)+t*((2*a-5*b+4*c-d)+t*(3*b-a-3*c+d)));
}

function surface(parent,name,nu,nv,wrap,point,material,tint) {
  const positions=[], colors=[], indices=[];
  const cols = wrap ? nu : nu+1;
  for (let j=0;j<=nv;j++) {
    for (let i=0;i<cols;i++) {
      const u=i/nu, v=j/nv;
      const p=point(u,v);
      positions.push(p.x,p.y,p.z);
      if (tint) {
        const c=tint(u,v,p);
        colors.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
      }
    }
  }
  for (let j=0;j<nv;j++) {
    for (let i=0;i<nu;i++) {
      const next=(i+1)%cols;
      const a=j*cols+i, b=j*cols+next;
      indices.push(a,b,a+cols,b,b+cols,a+cols);
    }
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions,3));
  if(tint) geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
  geo.setIndex(indices);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  return mesh(parent,name,geo,material);
}

function oval(parent,name,center,scale,material) {
  const o=mesh(parent,name,new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,40,28),material);
  o.position.set(...center);
  o.scale.set(...scale);
  return o;
}

const bodyY=[.235,.27,.39,.61,.87,1.09,1.34,1.58,1.82,2.08,2.29,2.41];
const bodyX=[.01,.39,.75,.974,1.047,1.029,.962,.855,.744,.65,.49,.015];
const bodyFront=[.05,.42,.735,.91,.985,.977,.878,.73,.55,.453,.33,.04];
const bodyBack=[.045,.38,.617,.775,.847,.867,.844,.793,.734,.678,.53,.045];
surface(trunk,'Continuous golden belly and haunches',112,76,true,(u,v)=>{
  const a=2*pi*u, s=v*(bodyY.length-1);
  const f=profile(bodyFront,s), b=profile(bodyBack,s);
  return vec(profile(bodyX,s)*Math.sin(a),profile(bodyY,s),
    -.055+(f-b)*.5+(f+b)*.5*Math.cos(a));
},paintedSkin,(u,v,p)=>{
  const chest=Math.pow(Math.max(0,Math.cos(2*pi*u)),2.5);
  return gold.clone().lerp(butter,.61*chest*Math.exp(-Math.pow((p.y-1.04)/.74,4)));
});

// The upper muzzle, cheeks, and lower jaw share the two edges of the gape.
const mouthAngle=1.255;
function opening(a) {
  const t=Math.abs(a)/mouthAngle;
  return t>=1 ? 0 : Math.pow(1-t*t,1.08);
}
function smileHeight(a) {
  const liftedCheek=Math.exp(-Math.pow((Math.abs(a)-1.12)/.65,2));
  return .021+.166*liftedCheek+.098*opening(a);
}
const widths=[1.094,1.112,1.119,1.088,1.034,.964,.882,.731,.510,.256,.001];
const fronts=[1.101,1.139,1.130,1.017,.787,.645,.606,.532,.404,.211,.001];
const backs=[.759,.769,.787,.809,.821,.806,.761,.652,.482,.247,.001];
const heights=[0,.049,.132,.347,.480,.591,.724,.855,.958,1.014,1.033];

function nostril(a,s) {
  const x=(Math.abs(a)-.263)/.053;
  const y=(s-3.035-.095*x)/.215;
  return Math.exp(-(x*x+y*y)*1.28);
}
function upper(a,s) {
  const f=profile(fronts,s), b=profile(backs,s);
  const edgeInfluence=s<=2 ? 1 : Math.max(0,3-s);
  const gum=smileHeight(a)*edgeInfluence;
  const d=nostril(a,s);
  return vec(profile(widths,s)*Math.sin(a),
    profile(heights,s)+gum-.014*d,
    .5*(f-b)+.5*(f+b)*Math.cos(a)-.031*d);
}
function upperNormal(a,s) {
  return upper(a+.001,s).sub(upper(a-.001,s))
    .cross(upper(a,s+.002).sub(upper(a,s-.002))).normalize();
}
function lowerEdge(a) {
  const p=upper(a,0), f=opening(a);
  p.y-=.726*f;
  p.z-=.191*f;
  p.x-=.042*Math.sin(a)*f;
  return p;
}
surface(head,'Rounded skull and dimpled muzzle',240,110,true,
  (u,v)=>upper((u*2-1)*pi,10*v),paintedSkin,(u,v)=>{
    const d=nostril((u*2-1)*pi,10*v);
    return gold.clone().lerp(nostrilBrown,Math.min(1,1.42*d));
  });

surface(head,'Rounded lower jaw and chin',160,48,true,(u,v)=>{
  const a=(u*2-1)*pi, p=lowerEdge(a);
  const t=(1-v)*pi*.5, r=Math.max(.0007,Math.cos(t));
  return vec(p.x*r,mix(p.y,-.818,Math.sin(t)),.024+(p.z-.024)*r);
},skin);

const mouth=group(head,'Broad laughing mouth');
function oralPoint(a,q) {
  const f=opening(a);
  const p=lowerEdge(a).lerp(upper(a,0),q);
  const hollow=Math.pow(Math.max(0,Math.sin(pi*q)),.80)*Math.pow(f,.76);
  p.z-=.433*hollow;
  p.x-=.114*Math.sin(a)*hollow;
  p.y-=.024*hollow;
  return p;
}

const throat=color(0x431c24), innerLip=color(0xa44836), mouthFloor=color(0x9a3942);
const oralMat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  vertexColors:true,roughness:.91,side:THREE.DoubleSide
});
surface(mouth,'Recessed mouth interior',130,56,false,
  (u,q)=>oralPoint((u*2-1)*mouthAngle,q),oralMat,(u,q)=>{
    const a=Math.abs(u*2-1);
    const c=throat.clone().lerp(mouthFloor,.72*Math.pow(1-q,2.6));
    const edge=Math.max(Math.pow(a,8)*.67,.61*Math.exp(-q*12),
      .52*Math.exp(-(1-q)*20));
    return c.lerp(innerLip,edge);
  });

function deformSphere(parent,name,fn,material,segments=64,rings=40) {
  const geo=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,segments,rings);
  const pos=geo.attributes.position;
  for(let i=0;i<pos.count;i++) {
    const p=fn(pos.getX(i),pos.getY(i),pos.getZ(i));
    pos.setXYZ(i,p.x,p.y,p.z);
  }
  pos.needsUpdate=true;
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  return mesh(parent,name,geo,material);
}

const tongueGroup=group(mouth,'Tongue');
const tongueMat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color:0xf1777b,roughness:.69,side:THREE.DoubleSide
});
deformSphere(tongueGroup,'Curled pink tongue', (x,y,z)=>{
  const split=Math.exp(-x*x/.030);
  const q=.218+.179*y-.033*split*Math.max(0,y)+.023*x;
  const p=oralPoint(.828*x,q);
  p.z+=.024+.130*z-.016*split*Math.max(0,z);
  return p;
},tongueMat);

const eyes=group(head,'Eyes');
for(const side of [-1,1]) {
  const eye=group(eyes,side<0?'Right squint':'Left squint');
  deformSphere(eye,'Raised crescent eyelid',(x,y,z)=>{
    const a=side*.518+.223*x;
    const s=5.25+.552*(1-x*x)+.042*side*x+.203*y;
    return upper(a,s).addScaledVector(upperNormal(a,s),.016+.036*z);
  },eyeMaterial);
}

// Soft limbs and tail are swept along spatial curves with varying thickness.
function sweep(parent,name,coords,radii,material) {
  const curve=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(coords.map(p=>vec(...p)),false,'centripetal');
  const n=56, sides=36, frames=curve.computeFrenetFrames(n,false);
  return surface(parent,name,sides,n,true,(u,v)=>{
    const j=Math.round(v*n), t=curve.getUtoTmapping(v);
    const p=curve.getPoint(t), r=Math.max(.001,profile(radii,t*(radii.length-1)));
    const a=-2*pi*u;
    return p.addScaledVector(frames.normals[j],r*Math.cos(a))
      .addScaledVector(frames.binormals[j],r*Math.sin(a));
  },material);
}

const tail=group(dragon,'Upturned dinosaur tail');
sweep(tail,'Tapering tail',[
  [.025,.84,-.42],[.11,.775,-.705],[.24,.711,-.976],
  [.405,.719,-1.218],[.563,.784,-1.397],[.679,.908,-1.497],
  [.744,1.035,-1.526],[.751,1.115,-1.50]
],[.432,.395,.316,.232,.156,.091,.044,.002],skin);

for(const side of [-1,1]) {
  const label=side<0?'Right':'Left';
  const leg=group(dragon,label+' leg');
  const thigh=oval(leg,'Short plump leg',[side*.565,.444,.005],[.339,.398,.342],skin);
  thigh.rotation.z=-side*.12;
  const foot=group(leg,label+' foot');
  foot.position.set(side*.588,0,.202);
  foot.rotation.y=side*.198;
  const footY=[.013,.023,.065,.129,.205,.279,.338,.369];
  const footX=[.19,.276,.33,.349,.333,.278,.177,.006];
  const footF=[.314,.423,.482,.515,.495,.394,.19,-.078];
  const footB=[.233,.29,.321,.324,.31,.277,.234,.088];
  surface(foot,'Soft three-toed foot',96,40,true,(u,v)=>{
    const a=(u*2-1)*pi, s=v*7, f=profile(footF,s), b=profile(footB,s);
    const rx=profile(footX,s), x=rx*Math.sin(a), c=Math.cos(a);
    const toeGrooves=Math.exp(-Math.pow((Math.abs(x)-.110)/.035,2));
    const front=Math.pow(Math.max(0,c),3);
    return vec(x,profile(footY,s)-.009*toeGrooves*front*Math.sin(pi*v),
      (f-b)*.5+(f+b)*.5*c-.029*toeGrooves*front*Math.sin(pi*v));
  },skin);

  const arm=group(dragon,label+' arm');
  const raise=side<0?.082:0;
  sweep(arm,'Bent arm',[
    [side*.687,1.622,.042],[side*.823,1.575,.091],
    [side*.969,1.435,.220],[side*1.022,1.306+raise,.365],
    [side*.986,1.245+raise,.504],[side*.912,1.249+raise,.617]
  ],[.173,.203,.195,.160,.136,.105],skin);

  const hand=group(arm,label+' hand');
  hand.position.set(side*.906,1.245+raise,.615);
  hand.rotation.z=-side*.19;
  const palm=oval(hand,'Palm',[0,0,0],[.153,.128,.118],skin);
  palm.rotation.y=-side*.28;
  for(let k=0;k<3;k++) {
    const digit=oval(hand,'Finger '+(k+1),
      [-side*(.115-.014*k),.056-.064*k,.032+.020*Math.sin(k*pi*.5)],
      [.104-.008*k,.049,.061],skin);
    digit.rotation.z=side*(.17-.09*k);
    digit.rotation.y=side*.24;
  }
  const thumb=oval(hand,'Thumb',[-side*.009,.091,.040],[.068,.075,.068],skin);
  thumb.rotation.z=-side*.34;
}

function contactShadow(x,z,w,d,opacity) {
  const mat=new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms:{intensity:{value:opacity},shade:{value:color(0x667778)}},
    transparent:true,depthWrite:false,
    vertexShader:`varying vec2 coord;
      void main(){
        coord=uv*2.0-1.0;
        gl_Position=projectionMatrix*modelViewMatrix*vec4(position,1.0);
      }`,
    fragmentShader:`varying vec2 coord;
      uniform float intensity;
      uniform vec3 shade;
      void main(){
        float r=dot(coord,coord);
        float alpha=pow(max(0.0,1.0-r),3.0)*intensity;
        gl_FragColor=vec4(shade,alpha);
        #include <colorspace_fragment>
      }`
  });
  const o=mesh(scene,'Soft ground shadow',new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w,d),mat);
  o.rotation.x=-pi/2;
  o.position.set(x,.002,z);
}
contactShadow(.065,-.12,3.04,2.24,.22);
contactShadow(-.59,.22,.98,1.30,.31);
contactShadow(.59,.22,.98,1.30,.31);

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffcf1,0xf1d6b9,1.66));
function light(x,y,z,hex,intensity) {
  const source=new THREE.DirectionalLight(hex,intensity);
  source.position.set(x,y,z);
  scene.add(source);
}
light(-3.6,6.0,4.3,0xfff5e3,1.89);
light(4.7,2.8,2.8,0xecf4ff,.68);
light(1.6,4.3,-4.2,0xfff1c9,1.33);

const ref=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1.855,1.855,1.855,-1.855,.1,50);
ref.position.set(2.84,2.69,10.15);
ref.lookAt(0,1.636,.036);
ref.updateMatrixWorld();
scene.updateMatrixWorld(true);

function render(t) {
  renderer.setRenderTarget(null);
  renderer.setViewport(0,0,240,240);
  renderer.setScissorTest(false);
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
}
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters:[dragon],render,ready:true};
render(0);
</script>
</body>
</html>
